nodes.label: Project site for #41: docs/index.html landing page on GitHub Pages, PR #65 merged and deployed
nodes.description:
Goal: implement issue #41, a polished public landing page for kg at cristian1a.github.io/kg/ served by GitHub Pages.
Instructions: user pasted a detailed brief (option A static page, no new deps, no invented metrics, keep example URLs, research agent skills, validate a11y/responsive); later asked to commit and push, give an updated repo About text, and check slow workflows.
Discoveries: README 'Ask the graph' output was stale (real left-out line is Document 1, Issue 2, Test 13 plus a calls note); npx skills CLI needs Node >= 22, skills@1.4.0 works on Node 21; headless Chrome clamps windows to 500 px so narrow widths need a same-origin iframe; grids need minmax(0, 1fr) or long pre lines overflow on phones; a GitHub incident (Actions, Pages, Webhooks degraded) slowed CI and Pages, and the legacy Pages build deployed while the Pages workflow still showed queued.
Accomplished: docs/index.html (self-contained, light/dark, real kg output) plus tests/test_site.py (8 link/asset tests, mutation-checked) and README site link; pytest 482 passed, ruff clean, html-validate clean, axe 0 violations, no overflow 320-1440 px; PR #65 opened on docs/41-project-site and merged (eb360b2); site live and byte-identical to main; example URLs still 200.
Next steps: user sets repo About website and description by hand; confirm the remaining main CI jobs for eb360b2 finish green; delete merged branch docs/41-project-site after confirmation; user to git switch main && git pull locally.
Relevant files: docs/index.html, tests/test_site.py, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/benchmark.md, docs/mvp-validation.md, docs/examples/

nodes.label: Issue #41: project site, a static landing page on GitHub Pages (merged via PR #65, live)
nodes.description:
What: docs/index.html, one self-contained page (inline CSS, ~20 lines of JS for copy buttons, no external requests, light/dark): what kg is, a real node card, how it works, quick start, the five example graphs, what we have learned (observed behaviour, limits, open questions), the benchmark with caveats, a docs index and project status; tests/test_site.py; README links to the site.
Why: the Pages root was a 404 and only example graphs had URLs.
Where: docs/index.html, tests/test_site.py, README.md, PR #65, merge eb360b2
Learned: benchmark shown as results with limits (17 + 6 stale questions, one run each, repos of 4-104 files; cards 1.00 vs code 0.94, 1.00 after a grading fix, 63% less context, slower 35 s vs 30 s); scrapy large-repo test shown as next experiment, not a result; deployment verified (site 200, same SHA-256 as main); only the repo About update remains, by hand.

nodes.label: Project site is one self-contained docs/index.html with real kg output, colour = provenance, docs linked on GitHub
nodes.description:
What: no build step or generator; the hero shows real kg query node module:etl.utils --brief output (re-run on a fresh clone) linking to the graph at that node; render's palette reused (blue parser, orange agent, green tests); every number sourced from docs/benchmark.md, docs/examples/README.md or docs/mvp-validation.md and said so.
Why: brief forbade new deps, fake output and invented metrics; Pages with .nojekyll serves Markdown as plain text, so docs link to GitHub; same colour code as the graph images.
Where: docs/index.html
Learned: skills used read-only, nothing installed: anthropics/skills frontend-design, vercel-labs web-design-guidelines, addyosmani accessibility; publish-to-pages skipped since Pages was already set up.

nodes.label: tests/test_site.py guards the site: local links, anchors, #node= deep links, examples linked, no root-relative or external URLs
nodes.description:
What: 8 tests: every local link, image and in-page anchor exists; no URL starts with / (breaks under /kg/); repo-file links and Markdown headings resolve; #node= deep links name real nodes; every docs/examples/*.html is linked; images have alt and dimensions; nothing loaded from outside.
Why: #41 acceptance asks for a link test, so a renamed example or doc breaks CI instead of the site.
Where: tests/test_site.py
Learned: six deliberate breakages on a temp copy were each caught; renaming docs or examples now requires updating docs/index.html.

nodes.label: Publish the project site and example pages with GitHub Pages from main:/docs
nodes.description:
What: Repo public; Pages serves docs/ (docs/.nojekyll): landing page docs/index.html at cristian1a.github.io/kg/, examples at /kg/examples/<repo>.html.
Why: Needs a public URL for the site and interactive examples; private-repo Pages needs a paid plan.
Where: docs/.nojekyll, docs/index.html, docs/examples/
Learned: The root 404 ended with PR #65; the user enabled Pages by hand; the legacy Pages build publishes on merge to main in about 30-60 s normally.

nodes.label: User to update the repo About: website to the site root, new description
nodes.description:
What: set Website to https://cristian1a.github.io/kg/ (was .../examples/my_first_data_project.html) and Description to 'Turn a codebase into a knowledge graph: a deterministic parser plus your AI agent, with provenance on every edge. Query it, see what a change may affect, or explore it as PNG/SVG or interactive HTML.'; topics unchanged.
Why: the site is live; the old description only said 'rendered as PNG/SVG or interactive HTML' and missed v0.2 query/impact and provenance.
Where: GitHub repo page, gear next to About.
Learned: must be done manually; the .env token cannot change repo settings. Not yet done at session end.

nodes.label: Confirm all three CI jobs on main (eb360b2) finish green after the GitHub incident
nodes.description:
What: after merging PR #65, the main CI run reported success with only the Python 3.13 job run; the 3.12 job and clean-install smoke were still queued, and the Pages workflow stayed queued although the legacy build had published.
Why: GitHub incident 'Degraded availability for GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages and Webhooks' (from 15:49 UTC, 2026-10-19) made API statuses inconsistent.
Where: GitHub Actions for eb360b2.
Learned: the same three jobs passed on the PR with the same code (~1.5 min); no re-run needed, the queue drains on its own.

nodes.label: Changes reach main only through a PR, even when the user says commit and push
nodes.description:
What: a 'commit and push' request is done as a branch (type/N-slug) plus a PR from the template; the user merges.
Why: CONTRIBUTING.md says main is reached only by PR.
Where: CONTRIBUTING.md
Learned: applied for #41 (branch docs/41-project-site, PR #65); the site goes live only after merge since Pages serves main.

nodes.label: Local web tooling: headless Chrome min 500 px window, skills@1.4.0 on Node 21, html-validate/axe via npx
nodes.description:
What: headless Chrome clamps window width to 500 px, so narrower layouts are measured in a same-origin iframe; the current npx skills CLI needs Node >= 22, pin skills@1.4.0; html-validate and axe-core run via npx without adding deps.
Why: machine has Node 21; screenshots below 500 px are crop artefacts.
Where: local environment
Learned: serve the page under a /kg/ base path to mimic Pages when checking layout and links.

nodes.label: Delete merged branches feat/1-cli-base, feat/2-json-schema, docs/12-samples, docs/41-project-site
nodes.description:
What: branches already merged into main were kept, now including docs/41-project-site (local and remote).
Why: deletions need the user's confirmation, which was not given.
Where: local git repo and origin.
Learned: command offered: git branch -d feat/2-json-schema docs/12-samples feat/1-cli-base docs/41-project-site; the user's local main is behind origin/main (git switch main && git pull).
